description: Explicit simultaneous stochastic ExtraAdam after all four one-evaluation rules failed. Each frozen outer step uses a joint predictor at current D/G, discards predictor Adam moments, replays the same data/latent/noise RNG states, differentiates both players at the joint prediction, and accepts each corrector update from original weights/moments. D is temporarily restored while G differentiates so fields are simultaneous in each stage. EMA/evaluation and outer clock advance only for accepted correction. Extra work: one full D/G forward/backward block and two Adam preview calls per outer step (2x model/gradient work); original accepted D/G counts, schedules, losses, seed streams, architecture and thresholds remain. Full source snapshots include all nine transformed legacy host functions and native GANTrainer wrapper.
initialization: retained audited CPU fixtures; native CUDA training and random draws

compute.accepted_updates: one accepted D and G per frozen outer step; predictor Adam moments discarded
compute.randomness: same minibatch/noise oracle replayed; no extra stream advancement
compute.comparison: equal outer/accepted steps only; NOT equal compute; wall time measured
compute.extra_tensor_work: parameter/moment snapshots, RNG snapshots/restoration, joint prediction/correction

checkpoint: memory stored in optimizer state; qualification continuation required after all 22
